headline: Court freezes assets of Silverton Components amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Silverton Components after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Silverton Components publishes annual sustainability report
body: Silverton Components released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Silverton Components signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Silverton Components announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Silverton Components cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Silverton Components lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Silverton Components reports record quarterly revenue
body: Silverton Components reported revenue growth of 25% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Silverton Components reports minor shipment delays at Austin plant
body: Silverton Components confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Austin plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Silverton Components reports record quarterly revenue
